newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-UNIBANKA OPENS NEW SAFE-DEPOSIT FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-UNIBANKA OPENS NEW SAFE-DEPOSIT FACILITY.

text.p: Unibanka, one of the leading Latvian banks, said on Wednesday it opened a new safe-deposit facility for 640 clients in its branch in the centre of Riga.
"During the reconstruction and renovation of the branch building a new safe-deposit hall has been built," the bank said in a statement.
The cost of using these facilities is between 50 santimes and two lats depending on the size of the box.
Unibanka earlier had 100 safe-deposit boxes in two of its Riga branches.
